claim.statement: A team without a platform team can run containers on a few machines with scheduler, ingress, PKI, secrets, registry, metrics, logs, GitOps and fault injection included, without assembling external infrastructure.

sources.quote: metrics, logs, GitOps, jobs and fault injection are compiled into that agent.
There's no control plane to assemble and no add-ons to install.

claim.measurable: Following docs/linux-servers.md on clean Ubuntu 24.04 VMs, the only software installed beyond distro packages is bun and relish; three nodes become healthy and a two-service app answers through the built-in ingress and resolves its peer by name.
